speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition better, could you describe when the hand tremors started and whether they occur when your hands are at rest or when you're trying to use them? Also, have you noticed any other symptoms like stiffness, slowness in movement, or changes in your sense of smell?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any stiffness or slowness in your movements, and have you noticed a change in your sense of smell or difficulty with balance? I will also request a neurological exam and MRI brain to evaluate for structural changes.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any difficulty with balance or frequent falls, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel or bladder habits? I will also request a DaTscan to evaluate dopamine transporter function in the brain.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Hypertension, medicated with aspirin and amlodipine. Family history of schizophrenia in his mother. No other significant medical or psychiatric history. Social history: Drinks 1-2 beers nightly and is a former cigar smoker.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that clarification. Since the tremor is unilateral and resting, accompanied by bradykinesia (soft speech, reduced facial expressions) and cognitive decline, I am highly suspicious of a parkinsonian disorder. REQUEST TEST: DaTscan

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal DaTscan result is unexpected for idiopathic Parkinson's disease, so I need to rule out other causes. Do you experience any involuntary jerking movements, or have you noticed any hallucinations or vivid dreams? REQUEST TEST: EEG

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal DaTscan and EEG, I need to investigate the cause of your cognitive decline and tremor further. Have you experienced any episodes of confusion, agitation, or rapid deterioration in your thinking abilities over the past few months? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the unilateral resting tremor, bradykinesia, and cognitive decline, but with a normal DaTscan and MRI, I suspect this may be essential tremor with comorbid dementia or a functional disorder, but the clinical picture strongly points to Parkinson's disease despite the normal scan, or potentially Vascular Parkinsonism given the hypertension history. DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease
